snippet.title: Witchy Tower trailer
snippet.description:
Witchy Tower on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4086280/Witchy_Tower/

Witchy Tower is an arcade platformer with one simple goal: Climb the infinite tower and avoid the consequences of your actions!
No bullshit, no micro-transactions, just an arcade game like it's 2005. You can even mod in your own characters by just tossing a couple of sprites into a folder!

Releases on NOVEMBER 1st on Steam and itch.io!
Wishlist now!

=== Features ===
* Addictive 2D tower-climbing gameplay
* Two modes
* Six unlockable characters
* Easy modding, play anyone you want: Simply use the template and drop your sprites into the game's "Characters"
* 15 Biomes
* 31 Achievements
* Infinite fun
* Featuring Bossy
